title.narrative: GTA PROJECT: PROMOTING LABOR & ECONOMIC JUSTICE FOR VULNERABLE WOMEN IN EL SALVADOR

description.narrative: The proposal presented aims to contribute to the advancement of labour rights and economic rights of women in their diversity in the workplace in El Salvador. In this sense, the first strategy will be to strengthen public officials responsible for dealing with cases of violence against women in the workplace, through training on labour rights from a gender perspective, with an emphasis on addressing violence in the workplace, as well as economic and property rights from a gender perspective, with an emphasis on women's right to access to property, guaranteeing attention with a gender and intersectional approach; On the other hand, spaces for dialogue are promoted between national and international networks of women and LGBTI population, who work for the rights of diverse women and LGBTI population; in addition, the generation of information and data on this issue is strengthened; finally, a collective entrepreneurship of women is reinforced, in their capacities, through technical assistance and productive equipment, to guarantee their access to property and achieve their economic empowerment.
